name: Occupancy Voxel Creation
definition: Converts a density matrix into a boolean occupancy mask, then applies a 2x2x2 convolution to identify fully occupied 2x2x2 blocks, returning a mask of such blocks.
summary: Occupancy Voxel Creation identifies fully occupied 2x2x2 blocks to reduce the active voxel domain, differing from compression methods by focusing on block-level density detection.
